## What

Brief summary of the change.

## Why

The reason behind the change — the problem it solves or the behavior it improves.

## How to test

Steps to verify the change locally.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused on one concern.
- [ ] Title follows `feat: / fix: / docs: / chore: / refactor: / ci:` prefix.
- [ ] No AI-generated boilerplate in commits or description.
- [ ] If adding a catalog entry: safety level is honest and explanation is plain English.
